description.value: Poke N Chat is a casual Gastown eatery specializing in poke bowls, ramen, and bubble tea, situated steps from the historic Steam Clock on Water Street. It is known for fresh ingredients and a cozy atmosphere with views of this Vancouver landmark. Cyclists exploring the waterfront or Gastown can order online for pickup or opt for delivery.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 92m. Total: 2 spaces.
